title: A Stochastic Nested Fixed Point Algorithm for Large-Scale BLP Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a stochastic nested fixed point (SNFP) estimator for random coefficients logit demand models that updates model parameters using stochastic gradients and performs demand inversion one market at a time. Relative to the conventional nested fixed point (NFP) estimator, SNFP substantially reduces memory requirements and computational cost, making estimation feasible in very large datasets. We establish the large-$T$ (number of markets) asymptotic properties of the estimator under regularity conditions. We also characterize the effect of sharing one block of simulation draws across markets and show how to correct for it. Monte Carlo simulations show that the SNFP estimator achieves statistical accuracy comparable to the NFP estimator, and in our benchmark a single online pass estimates a model with 100 million markets in about 5.5 hours. An empirical application using scanner data further demonstrates the practical advantages of SN

translated_title: 用于大规模BLP估计的随机嵌套不动点算法
translated_abstract: 我们为随机系数logit需求模型开发了一种随机嵌套不动点（SNFP）估计器，该估计器使用随机梯度更新模型参数，并逐个市场进行需求反演。相对于传统的嵌套不动点（NFP）估计器，SNFP大幅降低了内存需求和计算成本，使得在超大规模数据集上进行估计成为可能。我们在正则条件下建立了该估计器的大T（市场数量）渐近性质。我们还刻画了跨市场共享一组模拟抽样的影响，并展示了如何对其进行校正。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，SNFP估计器达到了与NFP估计器相当的统计精度，并且在我们的基准测试中，单次在线处理可在约5.5小时内估计一个包含1亿个市场的模型。基于扫描数据的实证应用进一步展示了SNFP的实际优势。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种随机嵌套不动点（SNFP）估计器，通过随机梯度更新参数并逐市场进行需求反演，大幅降低了内存需求和计算成本，使包含上亿市场的BLP需求模型估计成为可能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stochastic nested fixed point (SNFP) estimator that uses stochastic gradient updates and market-by-market demand inversion to substantially reduce memory requirements and computational costs, enabling BLP demand model estimation on datasets with hundreds of millions of markets.
